senses.gloss: विष- + अग्नि विष- + अग्नि, m. the fire of poison.
विष- + अङ्कुर विष- + अङ्कुर, m. a spear, a dart.
विष- + अन्तक विष- + अन्तक, m. Śiva.
विष- + अपह विष- + अपह, adj. antidotal.
विश्व- + आत्मन् विश्व- + आत्मन्, m. the soul of the universe, a name of Viṣṇu.
विष्टर- + उत्तर विष्टर- + उत्तर, adj. covered with Kuśa grass, MBh. 3, 1381.
विश्वास- + उपगम विश्वास- + उपगम, m. getting confidence, Śāk. d. 14.
विश्व- + कर्मन् विश्व- + कर्मन्, m. 1. the sun. 2. a son of Brahman, the artist of the gods. 3. a saint.
विश्व- + कृत विश्व- + कृत, adj. made by Viśvakarman (?), Chr. 38, 12.
विषाण-कोष विषाण-कोष, m. the hollow of a horn.
विशेष- + गुण विशेष- + गुण, m. a special quality, Bhāṣāp. 26, 89; 90.
पर्व(न्)- and विष्णु- + गुप्त पर्व(न्)- and विष्णु- + गुप्त, m. proper names.
विश्वास- + घात विश्वास- + घात, m. perfidy, treachery, Pañc. 101, 25.
विश्वास- + घातक विश्वास- + घातक, m. a traitor, Pañc. 52, 15.
विश्वास- + घातिन् विश्वास- + घातिन्, adj. perfidious, MBh. 3, 625.
विश्व- + चक्षस् विश्व- + चक्षस्, adj. all-seeing, Chr. 289, 2 = Rigv. i. 50, 2.
विश्व- + चर्षणि विश्व- + चर्षणि, adj. active, strenuous in everything, Chr. 291, 14 = Rigv. i. 64, 14.
विश्व- + जन विश्व- + जन, m. all men, mankind.
विष- + दायक विष- + दायक, m. a poisoner, Rām. 2, 75, 38.
विष- + दायिन् विष- + दायिन्, m. a poisoner, Kām. Nītis. 7, 26.
विश्व- + देव विश्व- + देव, m. a deity of a particular class, see विश्व.
विशेष- + धर्म विशेष- + धर्म, m. peculiar or different duty.

विश्व- + धारिन् विश्व- + धारिन्,
 I. adj., f. इणी, all-sustaining.
 II. m. a deity.
 III. f. इणी, the earth.
विषम- + नयन विषम- + नयन, m. Śiva.
विश्व- + नाथ विश्व- + नाथ, m. 1. a name of Śiva. 2. a proper name, Chr. p. 234, 1. 6.
विस- + नाभि विस- + नाभि, m. a quantity of lotusses.

विष्णु- + पद विष्णु- + पद,
 I. n. 1. the sky. 2. the sea of milk. 3. a lotus.
 II. f. दी, the Ganges.
विश्वास- + पात्र विश्वास- + पात्र, n. a confidential agent.
विष- + पुष्प विष- + पुष्प, n. the blue lotus.
विश्व- + पेशस् विश्व- + पेशस्, adj. containing all that is beautiful, Chr. 288, 16 = Rigv. i. 48, 16.
विशुद्ध-सत्त्व- + प्रधान विशुद्ध-सत्त्व- + प्रधान, adj., f. ना, having the nature of pure goodness, Vedāntas. in Chr. 204, 17.
विशेष- + भावना विशेष- + भावना, f. reflecting on, or perceiving, differences.
विश्वास- + भूमि विश्वास- + भूमि, f. a person worthy of confidence, Hit. 18, 7, M.M.
विश्व-मदा विश्व-मदा, f. one of the seven tongues of fire.
विष- + मन्त्र विष- + मन्त्र, m. a snakecatcher.
विश्व- + मूर्तिमन्त् विश्व- + मूर्तिमन्त्, adj. taking all forms, omnipresent, Viṣṇu, Johns. Sel. 90, 31.
विस्मय-कर्ष- + मूल विस्मय-कर्ष- + मूल, adj. caused by astonishment and joy, Daśak. in Chr. 183, 12.
विष- + मृत्यु विष- + मृत्यु, m. a kind of pheasant.
विष्णु- + रथ विष्णु- + रथ, m. Garuḍa.
विश्व- + राज् विश्व- + राज्, and in some cases, विश्वा-, m. an universal sovereign.
विस्तारित-वर्ण-संकर- + रुच् विस्तारित-वर्ण-संकर- + रुच्, adj. shining brilliantly by the mixture of colours, and, being very desirous of the mixture of the castes, Rājat. 5, 377.
विशेष-विक्रम- + रुचि विशेष-विक्रम- + रुचि, adj. desiring to attack the pre-eminently powerful, Bhartṛ. 2, 27.

विश्व- + रूप विश्व- + रूप,
 I. adj. taking all forms, omnipresent.
 II. m. Viṣṇu.
विश्व- + रेतस् विश्व- + रेतस्, m. Brahman.
विशेष- + लक्षण विशेष- + लक्षण, n. characteristic mark or sign.
विष्णुलिङ्गी विष्णुलिङ्गी, i. e. विष्णु-लिङ्ग + ई, f. a quail.
विशुद्ध- + वंश्य विशुद्ध- + वंश्य, i. e. विशुद्धवंश + य (vb. शुध्), adj. descended from a good family, Rājat. 5, 335.
विशेष- + वचन विशेष- + वचन, n. special or different text.
विष-वल्लरी विष-वल्लरी, f. a poisonous creeper, Bhartṛ. 1, 75.
विश्व- + वार विश्व- + वार, adj. (vb. वृ), containing every boon, Chr. 288, 13 = Rigv. i. 48, 13.
विशेष- + विधि विशेष- + विधि, m. 1. special rule or observance. 2. special form, Hit. 117, 19 (of a treaty).

1. विश् विश्, i. 6, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., Rām. 2, 43, 6),
 1. To enter, Hit. ii. d. 48.
 2. To enter in (with acc.), Bhag. 11, 29.
 3. To pierce, Rājat. 5, 217.
 4. To begin, Rām. 1, 11, 20.
 5. To sit down, Rām. 2, 82, 2.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. विष्ट, Penetrated, pervaded.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. वेश्य,
 I. f. या, A harlot, Hit. i. d. 135, M.M.
 II. n. The habitation of harlots.
 --Comp.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु,
 1. To enter after somebody, MBh. 1, 796.
 2. To enter, Pañc. 187, 25.
 --With आ आ,
 1. To approach, Hit. i. d. 2, M.M.
 2. To enter, Man. i, 29.
 3. To occupy, Chr. 35, 5.
 4. To proceed, Man. 1, 18. आविष्ट,
 1. Pierced, wounded, Rām. 3, 52, 20.
 2. Overpowered, affected with, [] Lass. 2. ed. 45, 18; possessed (by a demon, or by any sentiment), Pañc. 40, 18; Chr. 31, 15; 7, 21.
 3. Covered, Pañc. i. d. 73 (कञ्चुक-, by a coat of mail and by a snake's hide).
 4. Full of, Hit. 126, 17.
 --Caus. वेशय, To cause to enter, Bhag. 8, 10.
 --With अन्वा अनु-आ, To enter, MBh. 1, 5389.
 --With समुपा सम्-उप-आ,
 1. To enter, Rām. 2, 85, 15.
 2. To begin, Rām. 1, 62, 22.
 --With समा सम्-आ,
 1. To enter at once, Man. 1, 56.
 2. To enter, MBh. 1, 7272.
 3. To approach, Bhartṛ. 2, 81.
 4. To sit on, Man. 2, 119; Pañc. ii. d. 63. समाविष्ट, Endowed, Lass. 2, 2.
 --Caus.
 1. To put on, MBh. 3, 9913.
 2. To commit, Pañc. i. d. 106.
 --With उप उप,
 1. To sit down, Vikr. 15, 5; Chr. 11, 17.
 2. To encamp, MBh. 3, 659.
 3. To enter, to occupy, MBh. 1, 5389. उपविष्ट,
 1. Seated, Pañc. 68, 21; sitting, Daśak. in Chr. 184, 10; sitting quietly, Pañc. 53, 23; sitting down for performing, Pañc. 224, 15.
 2. Arrived, entered, Lass. 2. ed. 44, 3.
 --Comp.
 बल-, adj. endowed with, or possessed of, strength.
 --Caus.
 1. To cause to sit down, Vikr. 28, 18 (corr. वेशयति); to place, Man. 3, 208.
 2. To sit down, Pañc. 147, 6 (probably to be read, उपविश्य).
 --With उपोप उप-उप,
 1. To sit near, (with the acc.), MBh. 3, 11777.
 2. To sit down, MBh. 1, 4914. उपोपविष्ट,
 1. Surrounded, Rām. 1, 4, 26.
 2. Sitting, MBh. 1, 6959.
 --With प्रत्युप प्रति-उप, To sit down opposite to, MBh. 2, 1156 (perhaps प्रति is to be separated, and preposition belonging to the preceding word).
 --With समुप सम्-उप, To sit down, Vikr. 81, 4; MBh. 1, 8479.
 --Caus. To cause to sit down, Hit. 69, 5.
 --With नि नि, Ātm. (in epic [] poetry also Par., MBh. 1, 6960).
 1. To enter, MBh. 1, 7566.
 2. To descend, MBh. 1, 7308.
 3. To sit down, Śiś. 1, 19.
 4. To lie down, Pañc. 205, 8.
 5. To marry, MBh. 1, 1852.
 6. To be intent on, Man. 2, 8.
 7. To return, MBh. 3, 1426 (probably is to be read निर्वेश्य). निविष्ट,
 1. Situated on, Rām. 3, 53, 35.
 2. Arranged, Man. 9, 252.
 --Caus.
 1. To cause to enter, Man. 4, 171.
 2. To place, Rām. 1, 18, 21.
 3. To lay the foundation of, Hariv. 6521.
 4. With मनस्, To apply one's mind to, Man. 6, 35.
 5. To draw, Śāk. d. 42.
 6. To cause to lie down, to encamp, Śāk. 18, 23.
 7. To cause to marry, MBh. 1, 7138; to unite to a match, Śāk. d. 95.
 --With अभिनि अभि-नि,
 1. To sit down, to settle in (with acc.), Pāṇ. 1, 4, 47; figurat., Bhaṭṭ. 8, 80.
 2. To be very set upon, Daśak. in Chr. 190, 21. अभिनिविष्ट,
 1. Endowed with, Ragh. 2, 75 (Calc.).
 2. Fixed, Mālat. 19, 2.
 3. Determined.
 --Caus.
 1. To place, Śiś. 1, 15.
 2. To build, Ragh. 15, 29.
 3. To cause to be very set upon, Mālav. 28, 8.
 --With प्रत्यभिनि प्रति-अभि-नि, प्रत्यभिनिविष्ट, Pursuing pertinaciously, Mālat. 88, 22.
 --With प्रतिनि प्रति-नि, प्रतिनिविष्ट, Obstinate, Bhartṛ. 2, 4.
 --With वि-नि वि-नि, Caus.
 1. To cause to enter, Rājat. 5, 318.
 2. To join(?), Rājat. 5, 39.
 3. To place, Rājat. 5, 445.
 4. To suspend, Pañc. i. d. 160.
 --With संनि सम्-नि, संनिविष्ट, Entered, seated, Bhag. 15, 15.
 --Caus.
 1. To cause to enter, Man. 11, 202 (read संनिवेश्य).
 2. To cause to lie down, MBh. 3, 665.
 3. To unite, to join, Man. 1, 16.
 4. To place, Vikr. 73, 8; Ragh. 12, 58 (Calc.).
 5. To put on, Ṛt. 1, 7.
 6. To contemplate, Man. 12, 120.
 --With निस् [] निस्,
 1. To enjoy, Megh. 109.
 2. To return, to reward, MBh. 5, 4943.
 3. To embellish, Hariv. 7858.
 --With परि परि, see 2. विष् with परि.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To enter, Chr. 24, 50.
 2. To appear, Vikr. 71, 11.
 3. To begin, Rām. 1, 31, 28. प्रविष्ट,
 1. Entered, pass. and act., Śāk. d. 7; Rājat. 5, 13; 58.
 2. Entered upon, engaged in. Desider. विविक्ष, To wish to enter, MBh. 3, 10836.
 --Caus.
 1. To cause to enter, Pañc. 256, 1; to let enter, 16, 2.
 2. To introduce (with two acc.), MBh. 1, 4427; as one's wife, Chr. 6, 8.
 3. To lay up, Man. 8, 38. प्रव्च्शित, Called, or sent in.
 --With अनुप्र अनु-प्र,
 1. To enter after somebody, MBh. 1, 7800.
 2. To enter, Daśak. in Chr. 186, 13.
 3. To go through, Utt. Rāmac. 37, 10.
 4. To follow, to accommodate one's self to, Pañc. i. d. 78 (cf. Hit. ii. d. 50).
 5. To cohabit with. MBh. 1, 4275.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र,
 1. To enter, MBh. 1, 3303.
 2. To cohabit with, Man. 9, 8.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To enter, MBh. 1, 6741.
 2. To lie down, MBh. 3, 13149; to go to rest, Man. 4, 55.
 3. To cohabit with, Man. 3, 48.
 --Caus. To place, MBh. 1, 4274.
 --With अनुसम् अनु-सम्, To lie down after somebody, Ragh. 2, 24 (Calc.).
 --Cf. ἵκω, ἱκνέομαι; see 2. विश् and वेश.

2. विश् विश्,
 I. m.
 1. A man of the mercantile caste, Chr. 4, 19 (the king may be called lord of the Vaiśyas, because the Brāhmaṇas are theoretically his superiors, the Kṣatriyas his equals, and the Śūdras too base for being meant; but perhaps it has the following signification).
 2. A man in general.
 II. f.
 1. Family, tribe, Chr. 289, 5 = Rigv. i. 50, 5; Chr. 296, 3 = Rigv. i. 112, 3 [].
 2. Entrance.
 3. A daughter.
 --Cf. Goth. vaihts; A.S. with; O.H.G. ni-with, eo-wiht, neo-wiht.
† 1. विष् विष्, i. 1, Par. To sprinkle.

2. विष् विष्, ii. 3, वेविष्, Par. Ātm. To pervade, to embrace, etc. (ved.).
 --With the prep. परि परि, Caus.
 1. To present, to offer, Man. 3, 228; to offer food, MBh. 1, 7182 (where it is written with श् instead of ष्).
 2. To wait on, Rām. 1, 13, 14.
† 3. विष् ii. 9, विष्णा, विष्णी, Par. To separate.

4. विष् विष्, f. Excrement, Man. 4, 48.
 --Comp.
† विस् विस्, i. 1, Par. To go.
विश विश, see विस.

विष विष,
 I. m. and n. Poison, Pañc. iii. d. 83 (n.).
 II. n.
 1. Water.
 2. See विस.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Lat. virus; ἰός, ἴον; Lat. viola (poison is connected with blue, cf. विष-पुष्प, and Śiva's neck growing blue, by swallowing the poison churned out of the sea).

विषा विष् + आ,
 I. f. Excrement, Amarak.
 II. ind. Intellect.

विस विस (also विश and विष), probably curtailed विसर, or विसल (cf. [] both), i. e. वि-सृ + अ, n. The film or fibres of the stalk of the water-lily, Śāk. d. 66; Vikr. d. 94; MBh. 13, 4509; 12, 7877 (all with स्).

I. वि-शङ्क (cf. शङ्का), adj. Fearless; acc. कम्, adv., Daśak. in Chr. 196, 3.
 II. वि-शङ्क् + आ, f. Suspicion, Nal. 24, 41.
 --Comp.
विशङ्कट विशङ्कट (Pāṇ. 5, 2, 28, nevertheless for original वि-संकट), adj. Great, large, Bhaṭṭ. 2, 50; Mālat. 78, 2 (with स्); acc. टम्, adv. Vehemently, Pañc. 46, 5.

विशद विशद,
 I. adj.
 1. Of a white colour, Megh. 41; Śiś. 9, 26; Kir. 5, 12.
 2. Clear, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 3322.
 3. Pure, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2680; spotless, Śāk. d. 97.
 4. Evident.
 5. Beautiful.
 II. m. White, the colour.

विषद विष-द,
 I. adj.
 1. Giving [] poison.
 2. Shedding water.
 II. m. A cloud.
 III. n. Green vitriol.

विषाद विषाद, i. e. वि-सद् + अ, m.
 1. Lassitude, dejection, lowness of spirits, want of energy, fear, Draup. 8, 3; Chr. 40, 20; weakness, Mālat. 35, 9.
 2. Distress, affliction, sorrow, Vikr. 5, 11; Pañc. 221, 5.
 3. Disappointment, despair, Hit. i. d. 32, M.M.
 --Comp.
विशय विशय, i. e. वि-शी + अ, m. Doubt, uncertainty.
विशाय विशाय, i. e. वि-शी + अ, m. Sleeping and watching alternately.

विषय विषय (probably वि-क्षि + अ), m.
 1. A collection of villages.
 2. A country, Rājat. 5, 51; Pañc. 129, 14; a kingdom, Bhartṛ. 2, 12; Rām. 3, 54, 28 (यम-, The lower regions, death); a place, Śāk. 104, 14; Kir. 5, 38.
 3. Anything indigenous or peculiar to a province.
 4. Home, province, department, sphere, Vikr. 39, 14; Pañc. 4, 17 (जीवितव्य-, Duration of life); Pañc. 227, 22 (application); element, that which is peculiarly known to those who occupy themselves with it or live therein.
 5. Horizon, sight, a place which may be looked over by somebody, reach, Man. 8, 148; Hit. 28, 3, M.M.; Megh. 35; 101.
 6. Anything perceivable by the senses, an object of sense, Man. 1, 15; Vikr. d. 9.
 7. An object in general, Bhāṣāp. 36; अत्र विषये, Concerning this object, Pañc. 114, 20; धनविषये, Concerning wealth, Pañc. 139, 3; स्त्रीणां विषये, Concerning women, 27, 18; an object of art, Mālav. d. 29.
 8. Worldly object, affair, business, enjoyment, etc., Pañc. iii. d. 244; sensual enjoyment, Hit. iii. d. 116.
 9. Aim, Śiś. 9, 40.
 10. A religious observance.
 11. Refuge, asylum.
 12. A lover, a husband.
 --Comp.
विषाय विषाय, a denomin. derived from विष with य, Ātm. To turn into poison, Bhartṛ. 1, 34.
विशयिन् विशयिन्, i. e. विशय + इन्, adj. Dubious.

विषयिन् विषयिन्, i. e. विषय + इन्,
 I. adj., f. णी.
 1. Attached to sensual objects, carnal, sensual, Hit. ii. d. 144; voluptuary, Śāk. 68, 14.
 2. Conversant with worldly occupations, Hit. 13, 7, M.M.
 II. m.
 1. A king.
 2. Kāma.
 3. A sensualist.
 4. A materialist.
 5. A man of business.
विशर विशर, i. e. वि-शॄ + अ, m. Killing.

विसर विसर, i. e. वि-सृ + अ, m.
 1. Spreading, Kāvya Prak. 79, 9.
 2. A multitude, Mālat. 23, 14.

विसार विसार, i. e. वि-सृ + अ,
 I. m.
 1. Going smoothly, gliding.
 2. Expansion, Nalod. 1, 19.
 3. A fish.
 II. n. A wood.
 III. f. री, The region of the winds.

विशसन वि-शस् + अन,
 I. n.
 1. Dissecting.
 2. Killing, ruin, Utt. Rāmac. 96, 5.
 II. m. A crooked sword.

विशसितृ वि-शस् + इतृ, m., f. त्री, and n.
 1. Who or what dissects, Man. 5, 51.
 2. Who or what kills.

I. वि-शाख (cf. शाखा), adj. Branchless.
 II. m.
 1. Kārttikeya.
 2. An attitude in shooting, standing with the feet a span apart.
 3. A solicitor, a beggar.
 4. A spindle.
 III. f. खा, The sixteenth lunar asterism, Lass. 16, 18.
विशातन विशातन, i. e. वि-शातय, [] (Caus. of शद्), + अन, adj., f. नी, Causing to fall asunder, Bhāg. P. 3, 14, 4.
विशारण विशारण, i. e. वि-शॄ + अन, n. Killing.

विशारद विशारद,
 1. Learned, wise.
 2. Skilled, conversant with, Pañc. ii. d. 14; Chr. 5, 5.
 3. Famous.
 4. Bold, presuming.

विशाल विशाल (perhaps vb. श्रि),
 I. adj.
 1. Great, large, Hit. 14, 4, M.M.
 2. Broad.
 3. Eminent, illustrious, Hit. pr. d. 39. M.M.
 II. m. A sort of deer.
 III. f. ला.
 1. The city Ougein, Megh. 31, and another town.
 2. Bitter apple, Cucumis colocynthis.
विसल विसल, probably वि-सृ + अ (with ल् for र्), m. A shoot, a sprout.

विशालता विशाल + ता, f.
 1. Magnitude.
 2. Breadth.
 3. Distinction.

विशिख वि-शिख (probably from शिखा),
 I. m.
 1. An arrow, Chr. 34, 13; Rājat. 5, 221 (उत्खायमान-, adj. While the arrow was drawn out).
 2. An iron crow.
 II. f. खा.
 1. A sort of needle.
 2. A spade.
 3. A highway.
 --Comp.
विशिप विशिप, n. A house.

विशिष्टता वि-शिष्ट + ता (vb. शिष्), f.
 1. Excellence, distinction, Hit. pr. d. 42, M.M.
 2. Individuality, having distinguishing properties.
 3. Peculiarity, as of duty.

विशुद्धि विशुद्धि, i. e. वि-शुध् + ति, f.
 1. Purity, Man. 5, 67; 9, 9.
 2. Correctness.
 3. Purifying, purification, Bhag. 6, 12; Utt. Rāmac. 9, 17.
 4. Sameness.
 5. Removal of doubt.

विशेष विशेष, i. e. वि-शिष् + अ, m.
 1. [] Difference, Pañc. 219, 14; at the end of comp. words, Different, e. g. गति-, m. Different ways, Pañc. 247, 11. पुरुष-, This or that man, Pañc. i. d. 124.
 2. Special property, Hit. pr. d. 25, M.M.
 3. A change for the better, Mālav. 46, 9.
 4. Sort, kind, manner, Megh. 65; Hit. ii. d. 149; Pañc. 114, 25; a different object, Megh. 58.
 5. Excellence, superiority; विशेषेण, Particularly, Pañc. 142, 15; 162, 9; at the end of comp. words, Excellent; e. g. भक्ष-, m. Excellent food, Pañc. 113, 9; 117, 2, cf. my transl. n. 767; Vikr. d. 142.
 6. A limb.
 7. A mark on the forehead with sandal.
 8. Speciality, characteristic marks, Lass. 13, 4 (तपस्विन्-, of an ascetic).
 9. Abl. विशेषात्, Especially, Pañc. ii. d. 100; even more, just for that, Pañc. 109, 19.
 --Comp.

विशेषक विशेषक, i. e. वि-शिष् + अक,
 I. adj. Discriminative, distinguishing.
 II. m. and n.
 1. An attribute, a predicate.
 2. A mark on the forehead made with sandal, etc., and worn either as an ornament, Mālav. d. 40; Daśak. in Chr. 199, 4, or sectarial [] distinction.
 --Comp.

विशेषज्ञ विशेष-ज्ञ, adj.
 1. Deeply learned, Hit. 129, 9; iv. d. 98.
 2. Wise, intelligent.
 --Comp.

विशेषण विशेषण, i. e. वि-शिष् + अन,
 I. adj.
 1. Discriminative.
 2. Distinctive.
 II. n.
 1. Distinguishing, discriminating.
 2. An attribute, epithet, Vikr. 20, 3.
 --Comp.
विशेषणता विशेषण + ता, f. The state of being a distinguishing mark, Bhāṣāp. 60; cf. Kusumāñj. transl. pp. 13, 55, n.
विशेषणवन्त् विशेषण + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Having a distinguishing attribute, Bhāṣāp. 131.

विशेषतस् विशेष + तस्, adv. Especially, Hit. 80, 1, M.M.; particularly, Vikr. d. 62.
 --Comp.

विशेषवन्त् विशेष + वन्त्, adj.
 1. Peculiar.
 2. Excellent.
 3. Superior, better, Johns. Sel. 17, 73.
विशेष्यक विशेष्य + क (vb. शिष्), latter part of a comp. adj. in तद्वद्-विशेष्यक, i. e. तद्वन्त्-, Relating to an object possessing such an attribute, Bhāṣāp. 134; cf. Kusumāñj. transl. 61, 1-6.

विशोधन विशोधन, i. e. वि-शुध् + अन,
 I. n.
 1. Cleaning.
 2. Purifying, [] Rām. 1, 26, 19.
 3. Expiation, Man. 11, 143; 156.
 II. f. नी, The capital of Brahman.

विशोधित्व विशोधित्व, i. e. विशोधिन् + त्व, n.
 1. Cleaning.
 2. Purifying.
 3. Freeing from obstructions, clearing, Hit. iii. d. 86.

विशोधिन् विशोधिन्, i. e. वि-शुध् + इन्, adj.
 1. Cleaning.
 2. Purifying.
 3. Clearing.

विशोषण विशोषण, i. e. वि-शुष् + अन,
 I. adj.(?), Drying, Arj. 8, 8; the name of a weapon.
 II. n. Drying.
 --Comp.
विश्न विश्न, i. e. 2. विछ् + न, m. Splendour, Pāṇ. iii. 3, 90; vi. 4, 19.
विश्पति विश्-पति, m. Lord of the house, Lass. 100, 13 = Rigv. vii. 15, 7.
विश्पला विश्पला, f. A proper name, Chr. 296, 10 = Rigv. i. 112, 10.
विश्रणन and विश्राणन विश्रा̆णन, i. e. वि-श्रण् + अन, n. Gift, donation, Ragh. 2, 54 (आ).
विश्राणन विश्राणन, see विश्रणन.
विश्रम वि-श्रम् + अ, m. Rest, repose, quiet, Vikr. d. 42.

विश्राम विश्राम, i. e. वि-श्रम् + अ, m.
 1. Rest, repose, Pañc. 145, 9; Hit. i. d. 138, M.M.
 2. Stop, pause, Utt. Rāmac. 103, 13.

विश्रम्भ वि-श्रम्भ् + अ (also विस्रम्भ विस्रम्भ), m.
 1. Trust, confidence, Pañc. i. d. 306; ii. d. 190.
 2. Affection, Hit. 46, 1, M.M. (-आलाप, Affectionate talk).
 3. Sportive noise.
विस्रम्भ विस्रम्भ, and विस्रम्भिन् विस्रम्भिन्, see विश्र्˚.

विश्रम्भिन् विश्रम्भिन्, i. e. वि-श्रम्भ्, and विश्रम्भ, + इन्, also विस्रम्भिन् विस्रम्भिन्, adj.
 1. Trusting, confiding in.
 2. Trustworthy, MBh. 1, 5845 (स्).

विश्रय विश्रय, i. e. वि-श्रि + अ, m.
 1. Abode, asylum.
 2. Dependence upon.

विश्रयिन् विश्रयिन्, adj.
 1. Living or dwelling in.
 2. Depending on.
विश्रवस् वि-श्रवस्, m. A proper name, Rām. 3, 53, 30.

विश्रान्ति विश्रान्ति, i. e. वि-श्रम् + ति, f. Rest, repose, Vikr. d. 20; Kathās. 22, 104 (रतेस्--वासवेश्मेव विश्रान्त्यै--आवयोर् अभवत्, literally, It was for us like the sleeping-room of the goddess of love for reposing in).

विश्राव विश्राव, i. e. वि-श्रु + अ, m., and विश्रुति वि-श्रु + ति, f. Fame, celebrity, notoriety.
 --Comp.
विश्लथ वि-श्लथ् + अ, adj. Relaxed, Ragh. 6, 73; languid.

विश्लेष विश्लेष, i. e. वि-श्लिष् + अ, m.
 1. Separation, Pañc. 225, 18 (with सह); disunion.
 2. A chasm, Kathās. 2, 49.
 --Comp.
विश्लेषिन् विश्लेषिन्, i. e. वि-श्लिष् + इन्, adj. Falling, Ragh. 16, 67.

विश्व विश्व, probably वि-श्वि (cf. the aor. of श्वि, अ-श्वम्, and शश्वन्त्),
 I. adj.
 1. All, every, Lass. 97, 2 = Rigv. vi. 64, 1; every one, Lass. 101, 4 = Rigv. vii. 16, 1; particularly former part of comp. words, cf. विश्व-कर्मन्, विश्वकृत्, etc.
 2. Whole.
 3. Universal.
 II. m.
 1. A term of the Vedāntra philosophy, the faculty perceiving singleness, Vedāntas. in Chr. 209, 13.
 2. pl. (विश्वे), A class of deities, Indr. 2, 13.
 III. n. The world, Śāk. d. 1.
 IV. (n. and) f. वा, [] Dry ginger.
 V. f. वा, A tree, a plant, Aconitum ferox.

विश्वकद्रु विश्व + क-द्रु,
 I. adj. Wicked.
 II. m.
 1. A dog trained for the chase.
 2. Sound.

विश्वकृत् विश्व-कृ + त्, m.
 1. The creator.
 2. A son of Brahman, the artist of the gods (= विश्व-कर्मन्), Sund. 3, 13, cf. 10.
विश्वजनीन विश्वजनीन, विश्वजनीय विश्वजनीय, and विश्वजन्य विश्वजन्य, i. e. विश्व-जन + ईन, or ईय, or य, adj. Good for all men, universally salutary, Man. 9, 31 (-जन्य).

विश्वजित् विश्व-जि + त्,
 I. adj. All-subduing.
 II. m.
 1. A particular sacrifice, Man. 11, 74.
 2. The noose of Varuṇa.
विश्वञ्च् विश्वञ्च्, A false writing for विष्वञ्च्, q. cf.

विष्वञ्च् विष्वञ्च्, i. e. विषु-अञ्च्,
 I. adj., f. षूची, Going everywhere, all-pervading, Bhāg. P. 2, 6, 20.
 II. acc. वक्, adv.
 1. Every way, everywhere, Pañc. ii. d. 2.
 2. All about, Vedāntas. in Chr. 207, 11.
विश्वतस् विश्व + तस्, adv. Everywhere.
विश्वतुर् विश्व-तुर्, adj. All-subduing, Chr. 288, 16 = Rigv. i. 48, 16.
विश्वद्र्यञ्च् विश्वद्र्यञ्च्, i. e. विश्व + त्र-अञ्च् (with द् for त्; cf. also तिर्यञ्च्), adj., f. द्रीची, Moving everywhere.

विश्वप्सन् विश्वप्सन्, i. e. विश्व-भस् + अन् (properly the curtailed ptcple. of the pres.), m.
 1. A god.
 2. Fire.
 3. The sun.
 4. The moon.

विश्वंभर विश्वंभर, i. e. विश्व + म्-भृ + अ,
 I. adj. All-sustaining.
 II. m.
 1. Viṣṇu.
 2. Indra.
 III. f. रा, The earth, Utt. Rāmac. 7, 11.
विश्वसन वि-श्वस् + अन, n. Trusting, confiding in.
विश्वासन (or ना?), विश्वासन (or ना), i. e. वि-श्वस्, Caus., + अन, n. (or f.), Producing confidence, Pañc. 165, 15.
विश्वसनीयता i. e. वि-श्वसनीय + ता (vb. श्वस्), f. Inspiring confidence, Śāk. 27, 17.

विश्वसह विश्व-सह् + अ,
 I. adj. Allenduring.
 II. f.
 1. The earth.
 2. One of the tongues of fire.
विश्वसुविद् विश्व-सु-विद्, adj. Giving everything well, Chr. 287, 2 = Rigv. i. 48, 2.

विश्वसृज् विश्व-सृज् (nom. sing. -सृट् and सृक्, MBh. 14, 7367), m.
 1. The creator of the universe, MBh. 1, 1.; Śiś. 9, 80.
 2. Brahman.
विश्वाची विश्वाची, i. e. विश्व-अञ्च् + ई, f. The name of an Apsaras, Lass. 2. ed. 50, 22.
विश्वामित्र विश्वामित्र, i. e. विश्व-मित्र, m. The name of a Muni, Johns. Sel. 23, 118.

विश्वावसु विश्वावसु, i. e. विश्व-वसु, m.
 1. One of the Manus.
 2. One of the Gandharvas, Indr. 2, 18.

विश्वास विश्वास, i. e. वि-श्वस् + अ, m.
 1. Confidence, trust, Pañc. ii. d. 23.
 2. Faith, Vikr. 71, 13.
 3. Secret, Hit. 73, 16.
 --Comp.

विश्वासिन् विश्वासिन्, i. e. वि-श्वस्, and विश्वास, + इन्, adj., f. नी,
 1. Trusting.
 2. Trusty, honest.
 --Comp.
विश्वासैकसार विश्वासैकसार, i. e. विश्वास-एक-सार, m. A proper name, Rājat. 5, 44.
विश्वेभोजस् विश्वेभोजस् (i. e. विश्व and भोजस्), m. A name of Indra, Matsyapurāṇa, see Aufrecht, Ujjvalad. p. 250, n.

विषङ्ग विषङ्ग, i. e. वि-सञ्ज् + अ, m. Attachment.
 --Comp.
विषण्णता विषण्ण + ता (vb. सद्), f. Dejection, want of energy.
विषता विष + ता, f. State of poison, Śiś. 9, 68.
विषदर्शनमृत्युक विष-दर्शन-मृत्यु + क, m. A kind of pheasant.

विषधर विषधर, i. e. विष-धृ + अ,
 I. adj. Venomous.
 II. m. A snake.

विषम विषम, i. e. वि-सम,
 I. adj., f. मा.
 1. Unequal, different, Kir. 5, 40.
 2. Inconstant, Hit. ii. d. 104.
 3. Odd (in numbers), figurat., Pañc. i. d. 126.
 4. Unhappy, Hit. iv. d. 3.
 5. Unparalleled, unequalled, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 1.
 6. Uneven, Pañc. ii. d. 188; sloping, Vikr. 10, 9.
 7. Rough, Vikr. d. 49; Pañc. 188, 9.
 8. Difficult, painful, Bhartṛ. 2, 54; disagreeable, Pañc. i. d. 12.
 9. Frightful, Hit. iii. d. 133.
 10. Dishonest, wicked, Hiḍ. 1, 39; Hit. ii. d. 111.
 11. Partial, Man. 7, 27.
 II. n.
 1. Inequality.
 2. Oddness.
 3. Unevenness, Man. 1, 24 (uneven valleys, Jones).
 4. An inaccessible place, a precipice, Rām. 3, 51, 40; Pañc. 142, 6; a thicket, a pit, Man. 8, 232.
 5. Difficulty, pain, Pañc. v. d. 65; misfortune, Bhartṛ. 2, 95.
 --Comp.
विषमय विष + मय, adj., f. यी (Pañc. i. d. 211, या, but cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 119, read विषमय्यो), Poisonous.

विषमस्थ विषम-स्थ, adj.
 1. Standing unevenly.
 2. Being in difficulty or misfortune, Nal. 10, 1.
 3. Inaccessible, Pañc. i. d. 195.
 4. Safely posted.

विषमित विषमित, i. e. विषम + इत, adj.
 1. Made crooked, Kir. 10, 56.
 2. Made difficult to be walked on, Kir. 12, 50.

विषयायिन् विषयायिन्, i. e. विषय + यिन् (for विन्), m.
 1. A king.
 2. An organ of sense.
 3. Kāma.
 4. A sensualist.
 5. A materialist.
 6. A man of business.

विषहर विषहर, i. e. विष-हृ + अ,
 I. adj. Removing venom.
 II. f. रा and री, The goddess of the serpent race, the sister of Vāsuki.

विषाण विषाण, i. e. वि-सो + अन, m. (f. णी), and n.
 1. The horn of an animal, Bhartṛ. 2, 5; Pañc. i. d. 311.
 2. The tusks of an elephant or boar, Lass. 2. ed. 46, 24; Draup. 8, 21.
 II. f. णी, The name of two plants.
 III. n. Costus speciosus.
 --Comp.

विषाणिन् विषाणिन्, i. e. विषाण + इन्,
 I. adj.
 1. Having horns, MBh. 6, 71.
 2. Having huge tusks, Rām. 2, 52, 18, Seramp.
 II. m.
 1. Any animal with horns.
 2. A bull.
 3. An elephant.

विषादिन् विषादिन्, i. e. विषाद + इन्, adj., f. नी,
 1. Dejected, Bhag. 18, 23.
 2. Sorrowful, Man. 6, 57.

विषु विषु (probably a loc. pl. of द्वि, cf. वि), adv.
 1. Equally, same, alike.
 2. Many, various.
विषुव विषुव, विषुवत् विषुवत्, i. e. विषु + वन्त्, n. (व, by dropping the final त्), The equinox, Hit. 114, 22 (व).
विष्क् विष्क्, see वष्क्.

विष्कम्भ विष्कम्भ, i. e. वि-स्कम्भ् + अ, m.
 1. Obstacle, hindrance, resistance.
 2. The bolt of a door.
 3. A post, the roof-tree of a house.
 4. Spreading.
 5. A posture of the devotees, called योगिन्.
 6. Act, doing anything.
 7. The first of the twenty-seven astronomical periods called योगस्.
 8. A prelude.
विष्कम्भक विष्कम्भ + क, m. A prelude, Vikr. 36, 14; Śāk. 31, 13.

विष्कम्भिन् विष्कम्भिन्, i. e. वि-स्कम्भ् + इन्,
 I. adj. Obstructive, impeding.
 II. m. The bolt of a door.

विष्किर विष्किर, i. e. वि-कॄ + अ, m.
 1. A bird, Utt. Rāmac. 40, 13.
 2. Tearing to pieces.
 --Comp.

विष्टप विष्टप (cf. पिष्टप, and पिव् for पि-पा, s. v. 1. पा), m. and n. A world, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 3288.
 --Comp.

विष्टम्भ विष्टम्भ, i. e. वि-स्तम्भ् + अ, m.
 1. Obstacle.
 2. Stopping.
 3. Placing in or upon, planting (one's feet), Kir. 13, 16.
 4. Paralysis, loss of motion.

विष्टम्भिन् विष्टम्भिन्, i. e. वि-स्तम्भ् + इन्, adj., f. नी,
 1. Stopping.
 2. Checking.
 3. Making motionless.

विष्टर विष्टर, i. e. वि-स्तॄ + अ, m.
 1. A handful of Kuśa or sacred grass, MBh. 3, 1881.
 2. A seat made of twenty-five straws of Kuśa grass tied up in a sheaf.
 3. A layer, MBh. 15, 739; a bed.
 4. A couch, a seat, Vikr. 86, 15.
 5. The seat of a Brahman, either real or in effigy, as presiding at a sacrifice.
 6. A tree.

विष्टा विष्टा, (Pañc. 192, 16), and विष्ठा विष्ठा (Man. 3, 180; 4, 220; 10, 91), f. Fæces, ordure (cf. 4. विष्).
 --Comp.

विष्टि विष्टि, i. e. 2. विष् + टि,
 I. adj. and sbst. Working, a workman.
 II. f.
 1. Occupation, Chr. 294, 3 = Rigv. i. 92, 3; act, action.
 2. Unpaid labour.
 3. Hire, Rām. 2, 63, 55, Seramp.
 4. [] Sending, dispatching.
 5. Sending to hell.
विष्ठल विष्ठल, i. e. वि-स्थल, n. A place situated remote or apart.
विष्ठा विष्ठा, see विष्टा.

विष्णु विष्णु, i. e. 2. विष् + नु, m.
 1. Viṣṇu, one of the three principal Indian deities, Chr. 291, 7 = Rigv. i. 85, 7; Pañc. 44, 16.
 2. Agni.
 3. One of the Vasus.
 4. The name of an ancient law-giver.
 5. A pious man.
विष्णुमय विष्णु + मय, adj., f. यी, Emanated from Viṣṇu.
विष्पन्द विष्पन्द, i. e. वि-स्पन्द् + अ, m. Throbbing.
विष्फार विष्फार, i. e. वि-स्फर् + अ, m. The twang of a bow (cf. विस्फार).
विस्फार विस्फार, i. e. वि-स्फर् + अ, m. The twang of a bow.
विष्य विष्य, i. e. विष + य, adj. Deserving death by poison.
विष्यन्द विष्यन्द, i. e. वि-स्यन्द् + अ, m. Flowing, trickling.
विस्यन्द वि-स्यन्द् + अ, m. Flowing, trickling.
विष्वक्षेण विष्वक्षेण, and विष्वक्सेन विष्वक्सेन, i. e. विष्वञ्च्-सेन (see सेना), m. Viṣṇu, Bhāg. P. 8, 13, 24 (स्).
विष्वणन विष्वणन, n., and विष्वाण विष्वाण, m., i. e. वि-स्वन् + अन, or अ, Eating, food.
